description:
Searchable database of Google Maps business listings worldwide, refreshed every 30 days: query by name, category, address, city, ZIP, state, country or phone, or search inside a bounding box or radius (full business records with extended_details), plus a business's reviews and photos.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- search (required: country): Search
- search_post (required: country): Search (POST)
- area_search_by_bounding_box (required: country, top_right, bottom_left): Area Search By Bounding Box
- area_search_by_radius (required: country, lat, lng, radius): Area Search By Radius
- business_reviews (required: business_id): Business Reviews
- business_photos (required: business_id): Business Photos

When to use: Use to build business datasets and lead lists: it returns every listing matching the filters, cost-effectively. For a live, up-to-the-minute Google Maps lookup use local_business_data.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: local_business_database
